notes: Both coordinated passive participles are read as substantives under rule 46; only the supplied possessive *his* is left `added` (rule 18, closing sentence).

`שָׁפְכָה` → *privy member* heads on *privy*: the subtraction test ties and the ASV never writes *member* alone for this noun, so *member* is the supplied generic (rule 31). Heading on *member* was the competing reading.
`בִּקְהַל` is split because the ASV spends a word on each morpheme, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet.
